A_ground_truth_and_metric_scale.details: Identity/camera/scene arrays come from protocol records. RGBNT201 uses all 836 query and 836 gallery records. Camera scoring removes only same-ID AND same-camera gallery entries, retains other distractors, asserts a legal positive for every query, and computes AP/CMC from ranks. Scoring is checked against the pinned author evaluator. Feature L2 normalization and multiplying metrics by 100 are conventional; no own-score max/min/mean denominator is used. The dataset/protocol bytes and author evaluator are remote inputs and were not re-read remotely. Training sensitivity is explicitly a model-derived proxy, not inference ground truth.

B_constructor_schema_best_and_inference.details: The producer configure chain reaches independent-native foundation.build/build_core using the original global-task/role-detach/partition builders. The diagnostic namespace explicitly supplies mode=evaluate, semantic variant/recipe, exposure, seed42, epochs50 and all original paths. Foundation.build compares schema and complete initializer binding; load compares schema/dataset/condition/protocol and loads strict state. Recomputing max(mAP, epoch) matches the producer latest-tie policy and both saved E8 receipts. GlobalTaskRoleHeads inference returns the exact core fused output, so direct forward_features is the deployed feature path. eval plus inference_mode takes the no-label/no-VJP branch; training-only exposure is asserted absent. No optimizer, new checkpoint, selection search, inference exclusion or added module is executed by this diagnostic path.

C_same_forward_arrays_and_control_proven.details: One core forward per query/gallery batch returns G, C, H and F together; each tensor must be finite and 836x1536. The original nonshuffling inference loader is reused. H=G+gain*C and F=L2(H) are explicitly checked. Three distance matrices and all four feature arrays per split are saved and hashed. All six metadata vectors must equal both original first-strict arrays and the separately sealed global-only saved distances. The protected historical control seal hash and its global-only distance hash are checked by deployment; no independent-global model is rebuilt or rerun. The control JSON is inspected, but its remote binary is not independently loaded or rehashed by this auditor. New arrays do not yet exist.

D_frozen_state_gradients_and_reachable_m.details: model.eval runs before extraction; the inherited train(mode) implementation propagates eval to Signal. All persistent state_dict entries, including parameters and persistent buffers, are hashed before/after extraction; all parameter grads must be None both times. Output exposure and role exclusion must be None. Scores, geometry and paired per-query/identity results are all called and inserted into DIAGNOSIS.json; no claimed diagnostic depends on dead reporting code. These are runtime assertions, not runtime observations from this audit.

E_tolerances_failed_outcomes_and_scienti.details: The diagnostic fixes fused-distance max absolute difference <=1e-5 and all four metric differences <1e-5; decomposition uses atol=rtol=1e-6. The stricter metric inequality does not relax the plan. Assertions stop execution; the controller retains the unique child log and nonzero EXIT and stops the second arm after a first-arm failure. No original receipt or checkpoint is overwritten. A failing numeric check may leave only traceback/log/EXIT rather than a DIAGNOSIS.json because output creation follows the checks. Plan and saved summary label results as selected-best descriptive diagnostics, not independent ablations or causal proof. The original negative gradient-random result and unmet goal are not revised. Historical independent_upstream_metrics_equal is correctly identified as scorer agreement on fused ranking, not the model own global score.

F_environment_one_attempt_and_launch_con.details: The exact audited deployment transport reads readiness plus the three deployed files using C:/ path keys, rechecks original collected files, all469 runtime pins and all15 M0 bindings, gates full926 COMPLETE and EXIT0 plus original PID absence, pins protected control/CLIP/protocol, and refuses an existing admin directory. It deploys only the new inference tool, controller and plan, then writes the new seal. There are one prepare SSH call and one launcher SSH call, both to port2026; no retry loop, environment install, source overwrite, baseline neural replay or preemption. The controller checks only GPU0/1 memory, requires both under500MiB and256MiB free disk, uses the existing tri_reid Python with CUDA_VISIBLE_DEVICES=0,1, and awaits exactly gradient then random. The supervisor awaits the worker and records its true return code. LAUNCH transport success is not terminal diagnosis success. The plan ETA2-4min and180-300sec polling are estimates/operating instructions; no observer is included or executed. Actual remote admission and launch remain pending.
